Subject: Evening group demo — handoff timelines + waitlist protocol

Hi Sara / Tim —

Thanks again for signing up for our evening group demo next week. A couple of quick items as we stitch the calendar:

- We run the evening slots as a shared bridge (max 6 customers per slot). If we exceed capacity we keep a waitlist and offer the next available evening slot within 48 hours.
- For enterprise accounts we can reserve a 45-min VIP slot; otherwise the group demo is 30 minutes + 10 minutes of follow-up in the lobby.
- Please let me know if either of you need a private 1:1 instead of the group session (we can do a dedicated follow-up).

Proposed times (PDT):
1) Thu Aug 6 — 6:00pm - 6:30pm
2) Fri Aug 7 — 7:00pm - 7:30pm

If one of those works, reply with preferred slot and a short note on top priorities (latency, embeddings scale, or private deployment). I’ve cc'd Ben and Karthik so they can cover any infra/security questions on the call.

Attaching the slide deck we typically show and a short mutual action plan draft — please treat them as stubs until we confirm the slot.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.ai
Attachments: demo-deck-redwood-v2.pdf (pdf), MAP-Acme-Retail.docx (docx)

Thanks Naomi —

Either slot should work for us but Friday at 7pm PDT is preferable (we have a team standup conflict Thu evening). Quick ask: could we shorten the demo to 25 minutes and leave more time for Q&A? Our director wants more time to talk about compliance (data residency, audit logs). If possible, can someone from security join or we get a short pre-call note on where Redwood lands on retention and SOC2 evidence?

Also looping Tim who will be on the call.

—Sara
